description: Head-movement mini-game GA09: left/right dodge game. Voice-guided, segmented motion only — 10 fixed rounds, one obstacle at a time; turn AWAY from the obstacle, hold 0.8 s to dodge, then return to center before the next round. A one-prompt start calibration (turn left once) learns which yaw sign means left. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: turn-dodge
